diagrams.title: Before: baseline tenant gates
diagrams.description: Trusted predicates and quotas exist, but do not implement enterprise identity/audit/network deployment.

diagrams.title: After: verified audited disclosure
diagrams.description: Untrusted headers/documents remain data. Verified service/user scope, current authority, audit and constrained egress gate model context.

diagrams.title: Security request sequence
diagrams.description: Verify, bind, govern, resolve, audit and egress. Spoofed scope and stale authority cannot disclose text.

lab_assumptions: Toy policy freshness expires at 30 seconds. Document is assumed current/readable and audit succeeds; no real identity/network integration.
